formal.statement: theorem stoll_cycle_audit_certificate : Nat.Prime 5 ∧ (5:ℕ)≠3 ∧ addOrderOf (cycleMap 1)=5 ∧ (cycleMap 1).val.u=X ∧ (cycleMap 1).val.v=1 ∧ Fintype.card ReducedPair=10 ∧ Fintype.card {P : ReducedPair // P.u.Splits}=8 ∧ Fintype.card CyclePair=5 ∧ Fintype.card {P : CyclePair // P.val.u.Splits}=5 ∧ (¬ ∀ P : ReducedPair, ∃ Q : CyclePair, Q.val=P) ∧ (∀ P Q : CyclePair, ExplicitCantorStep P.val Q.val (P+Q).val) ∧ (∀ P Q : CyclePair, ∃ d U : K[X], d=gcd (gcd P.val.u Q.val.u) (P.val.v+Q.val.v) ∧ d.Monic ∧ U.Monic ∧ d^2*U=P.val.u*Q.val.u) ∧ cycleFraction=1 ∧ ambientFraction=4/5 ∧ cycleFraction≠ambientFraction
formal.scope: Complete ten-pair model and actual Cantor-matched five-pair cyclic arithmetic image; no full ten-pair ambient group or geometric Picard identification.

identity.scope: Only scalar x5-plus-one quadratic quotient/remainder identity; count, splitting, actual gcd, all25Cantorsteps, generation/order/proportion rest on Lean.
